#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

const int MOD = 1000000007;

class InputReader {
public:
    InputReader(istream& s) : stream(s) {}
    
    int readInt() {
        int c = read();
        while (isSpaceChar(c)) {
            c = read();
        }
        int sgn = 1;
        if (c == '-') {
            sgn = -1;
            c = read();
        }
        int res = 0;
        do {
            if (c < '0' || c > '9') {
                throw invalid_argument("InputMismatchException");
            }
            res *= 10;
            res += c - '0';
            c = read();
        } while (!isSpaceChar(c));
        return res * sgn;
    }

private:
    istream& stream;
    
    int read() {
        return stream.get();
    }
    
    bool isSpaceChar(int c) {
        return c == ' ' || c == '\n' || c == '\r' || c == '\t' || c == EOF;
    }
};

class OutputWriter {
public:
    OutputWriter(ostream& s) : out(s) {}
    
    void print(int i) {
        out << i;
    }
    
    void close() {}

private:
    ostream& out;
};

class Solve {
public:
    int solve(int n) {
        int dp[2 * n + 1][2 * n + 1][2];
        memset(dp, 0, sizeof(dp));
        dp[0][0][0] = 1;
        for (int depth = 1; depth <= 2 * n; depth++) {
            for (int opened = depth & 1; opened <= depth; opened += 2) {
                if (opened - 1 >= 0) {
                    dp[depth][opened][0] = (dp[depth][opened][0] + dp[depth - 1][opened - 1][1]) % MOD;
                    dp[depth][opened][1] = (dp[depth][opened][1] + dp[depth - 1][opened - 1][0]) % MOD;
                }
                if (opened + 1 <= n) {
                    dp[depth][opened][0] = (dp[depth][opened][0] + dp[depth - 1][opened + 1][1]) % MOD;
                    dp[depth][opened][1] = (dp[depth][opened][1] + dp[depth - 1][opened + 1][0]) % MOD;
                }
                dp[depth][opened][0] = (dp[depth][opened][0] + 1) % MOD;
                dp[depth][opened][1] %= MOD;
            }
        }
        return dp[2 * n][0][1];
    }
};

int main() {
    InputReader in(cin);
    OutputWriter out(cout);
    int n = in.readInt();
    Solve solver;
    int ans = solver.solve(n);
    out.print(ans);
    return 0;
}
